title: Chapter 404 - 404 Apologize; Admit Cowardly!
content:
Chapter 404 - 404 Apologize; Admit Cowardly!

Chapter 404 - 404 Apologize; Admit Cowardly!

404 Apologize; Admit Cowardly!

Ling Rou hugged Lin Fan and felt his warm and broad chest.

She roughly explained what had happened.

Lin Fan’s face immediately darkened. His eyes shot out two rays of cold light like sharp blades, shooting toward Dai Jiexi, who was standing not far away.

Dai Jiexi’s heart trembled inexplicably, and she involuntarily took two steps back.

However…

It was useless.

Lin Fan strode forward and slapped Dai Jiexi’s heavily made-up face.

Two whip-like sounds echoed back and forth at the scene.

Two bright palm prints immediately appeared on Dai Jiexi’s face, and it gradually swelled up.

Lin Fan said coldly, “Apologize to Ling Rou.”

These two slaps stunned Dai Jiexi.

After hearing Lin Fan’s words, she finally reacted and shouted, “How dare you hit me?!”

As soon as she finished speaking, she stretched out her palm and was about to grab Lin Fan’s face.

Lin Fan said sternly, “Looks like you didn’t understand me!”

As he spoke, he raised his hand and slapped Dai Jiexi’s face again.

Dai Jiexi’s already red and swollen face gradually turned into something like a pig’s head. Tears flowed down uncontrollably as she looked at Lin Fan with fear in her eyes.

She was scared of being beaten!

At this moment, a man in a white shirt walked over quickly.

“What’s wrong, Jiexi?” he asked.

When Dai Jiexi saw the person who came, she looked like she had found her savior. She said in a panic, “Zheng Lei, you’re finally here. Look at how he beat me up. Quickly take revenge for me.”

Zheng Lei was Dai Jiexi’s manager. Like Lin Fan and Li Fei, he could not walk the red carpet.

That was why he had only come over now.

At this moment, Zheng Lei saw Dai Jiexi’s swollen face, which looked like a pig’s head. He was extremely furious.

Dai Jiexi’s popularity was largely due to her good looks.

Now that her face had been beaten to such a state, it would definitely affect her popularity.

Having her popularity be affected meant that his income would also be affected.

Zheng Lei was about to shout angrily.

At this moment, another set of footsteps could be heard not far away.

It was Wang Haohua, the chairman of Xin Mei Entertainment.

Even though the Golden Melody Awards were a huge deal, a chairman like Wang Haohua would not attend personally.

However, it was different this time…

This time, the boss’ woman was nominated for the first time. She might even win an award.

He also received news that Boss Lin Fan had come personally.

In that case, Wang Haohua would not be absent.

When he saw Lin Fan and Ling Rou from afar, he quickly walked over and bowed slightly. He said respectfully, “Hello, Mr. Lin, Ms. Ling.”

Lin Fan just glanced at him and did not say anything.

Zheng Lei, who was about to berate him, shut his mouth.

One had to know…

Xin Mei Entertainment was one of the top three companies in the entertainment industry.

Even Wang Haohua, the chairman of Xin Mei Entertainment, had to be so respectful to the young man in front of him.

In that case, the identity of this young man was worth considering.

“So, it’s Chairman Wang. There must be some misunderstanding about what happened just now…” Zheng Lei said.

With that, he pulled Dai Jiexi and prepared to leave.

Dai Jiexi was very unhappy.

However, she was not stupid. She could only pout and leave.

Lin Fan said coldly, “You haven’t apologized. Who allowed you to leave?”

Dai Jiexi was already unhappy. At this moment, she heard Lin Fan’s words, and she saw that many people were already gathering around her.

She became bolder and shouted, “I’m leaving. If you have the ability, continue to hit me!”

Dai Jiexi continued walking forward.

Lin Fan took a step forward and raised his hand again.

Two more slaps landed on Dai Jiexi’s face.

Immediately, a trickle of fresh blood slowly flowed out from the corner of her mouth.

Not only did Lin Fan attack, but his strength was even stronger than before!

Dai Jiexi’s face was filled with fear and disbelief.

There were so many people standing around. She did not expect Lin Fan to dare to hit her.

Zheng Lei opened his mouth, wanting to say something.

However, when he saw Lin Fan’s cold gaze, he swallowed his words.

“Apologize. I don’t want to say it again,” Lin Fan said calmly.

Dai Jiexi could not help but tremble. Her mouth seemed to be out of control as she stammered, “Yes… I’m sorry…”

Lin Fan said coldly, “Not to me but to Ling Rou!”

Dai Jiexi said again, “I’m sorry…”

Then, she ran forward as if he was escaping.

Seeing this…

The surrounding crowd also dispersed.

They understood that it was not necessarily a good thing to know too much about some things.

Lin Fan hugged Ling Rou’s waist and said, “Are you feeling better now?”

“Yes, yes!” Ling Rou nodded vigorously, feeling extremely sweet inside her heart.

On the other hand, Li Fei and Wang Haohua, who were beside him, had a worried look on their faces.

…

Dai Jiexi placed ice on her swollen face and shouted, “I was just beaten up. What were you doing there? You didn’t even let out a word. Are you even a man?!”

Zheng Lei found an excuse and said, “I… I was just worried that the more I spoke, the more disadvantageous it would be for you…

“Didn’t you see that even Wang Haohua, the chairman of Xin Mei Entertainment… was so respectful to that young man? He’s definitely an extraordinary big shot!”

In fact, this was only one of the reasons.

More importantly, he was afraid.

He was scared by Lin Fan’s tall figure and his strength.

What if he opened his mouth and got beaten up?

Dai Jiexi felt that what Zheng Lei said made sense.

However, she still said angrily, “But you couldn’t just stand there and say nothing!”

“By not saying anything, it could calm him down a little,” Zheng Lei said. “I’ll make him think that we’re cowards. However, we can find trouble with him afterward!

“Jiexi, aren’t you close to Sister Ni Min?” Zheng Lei asked after a pause. “I just received news that the guest of honor for this award ceremony has been changed to Sister Ni Min.

“She’ll be here later. You just have to tell Sister Ni Min about this later. Do you think Sister Ni Min will let them have a good time?

“No matter how powerful that man’s background is, can he compare to Sister Ni Min? Is he comparable to the Tang family?”

When Dai Jiexi heard this, her eyes immediately lit up. “Really? Sister Ni Min is the guest presenter?”

“How can it be fake? I heard it from the executive director,” Zheng Lei said.

“Good! When we meet Sister Ni Min later, I want to see how arrogant he and that b*tch Ling Rou can be!” Dai Jiexi grinned hideously.

It was as if she could already see Lin Fan and Ling Rou being ravaged by her.
